ci.workflow: Real example images and footer evidence
ci.checkout_provenance: Capture job log confirms GitHub PR merge of the branch head; manifest source_commit is preserved unchanged.

bounds.note: Manifest dialog_bounds_dp describes the outer Dialog layout box, not the visible white card. Image reachability is established against scroll_viewport_bounds_dp.

visual_findings: All six ad help images show the real Proxo field capture, translated caption, full selectable URL and close control; no visible clipping.
All twelve page type/style combinations show the expected content and lavender, mint, dark or white styling.
All twelve bottom captures show the complete sponsor credit, Proxo logo, Privacy Policy and Terms & Conditions, followed by the app caption.
Top and bottom pairs show the full image is scrollable. No blank examples, wrong styles or clipped footers were observed.
limits: Headless Flutter widget captures with fictional data; not native device, live customer, network latency or performance evidence.
Page selection behavior was checked at 393 dp/1x and 320 dp/1.6x; the 24 page PNGs are the 393 dp/1x top and bottom views only.
Thirty of the forty-eight copied PNGs were manually reviewed in this pass: six ad-help and twenty-four page-selection captures. Remaining localized page-help PNGs retain CI checks and metadata.
The source ad screenshot has a fixed Kurdish field label; surrounding dialog title and caption are localized. The horizontal URL input shows a visible prefix, with the complete selectable URL below.
Footer links are pixels inside example images and are not interactive; live footer destination availability was not tested here.
The footer pixel check establishes nonblank paint, while the separate production-renderer footer audit and visual inspection establish footer contents.
The dialog header and close control scroll with content and are absent from bottom captures; tests scroll back and close successfully. These static captures show no scrollbar thumb.
